content: With BertSum, vector $t_i$ which is the vector of the $i$-th [cls] symbol from the top layer can be used as the representation for $sent_i$. Several inter-sentence Transformer layers are then stacked on top of Bert outputs, to capture document-level features for extracting summaries:
